name: match-stmt-type-narrowing-test-2f777af370/match-stmt-type-narrow-negative-e.bal
spec_references: ## Statements: Match statement — Currently only supports const-pattern and wildcard-match-pattern
reason: The negative assertions concern duplicate/unreachable match clauses after type guards on variables bound by var and mapping patterns. These binding match patterns are essential to the test and exceed the explicit const-pattern/wildcard-match-pattern restriction, even though type-test expressions are supported.
unsupported_constructs: Variable-binding match patterns such as var a with type guards
Mapping binding/match patterns, including rest bindings, in match clauses
test_design_notes: The @error markers assert compile-time rejection of guarded match clauses; negative testing does not remove the dependency on unsupported match patterns.
